summary: Iteration 260 — tested new queue-board endpoint, enriched sales-return detail (backend pytest 10/10 PASS), plus UI: Pusat Persetujuan ApprovalDecisionModal (open/detail/Esc/backdrop/open-full/approve E2E/readonly), POS FacetRail chip previews + Semua Filter popup, Retur Jual list (peta retur, status+tipe filters, Nilai/Umur columns) and Retur detail (ReturnStepper, Harga/Nilai, estimasi total, Setujui). 2 blocking frontend defects found: (1) POS 'Semua Filter' modal is painted UNDER the catalog cards and its Apply/Reset buttons are pointer-intercepted; (2) all 3 'peta retur' links navigate to a BLANK screen (prop-arity mismatch in AppViewRouter).

ui_bugs.issue:
Pop-up 'Semua Filter' renders BELOW/behind the POS catalog product cards. Overlay is inline (not portaled) with z-[60] while .product-card has `transform: translateY(0)` (styles/components.css:216) creating stacking contexts that paint above it; other POS modals use z-[110]-[130]. Playwright normal click on facet-modal-reset/facet-modal-apply fails: '

... subtree intercepts pointer events'. document.elementFromPoint over the Apply button returns a product-card

. Modal is also visually clipped and the dim backdrop does not cover the cards. Real users cannot reliably click chips/Terapkan/Reset.

'peta retur' links open a BLANK screen (breadcrumb 'WORKSPACE › KSC / Kain Nusantara', empty <main>, no hub tabs; sidebar highlights 'Hutang Supplier (AP)'). RCA: router passes onNavigate={(target) => onNavSelect(target, target)} (single arg) but MapLink calls onNavigate(target.navId, target.view, target.tab) → activeView becomes the navId ('accounts-payable') so no view matches. Fix: onNavigate={(navId, view, tab) => onNavSelect(navId, view, tab)} (same as ApprovalInbox at line 327). Affects return-map-purchase-returns, -interco-transactions, -return-policies.

When the per-kind detail fetch is denied (salesadmin opening a Harga Khusus item → 403 'Anda hanya dapat mengelola pengajuan Anda sendiri'), the modal still renders the detail grid with misleading placeholders: PRODUK '—', PELANGGAN '—', HARGA NORMAL 'Rp 0', HARGA DIMINTA 'Rp 0', DISKON/ALASAN '—' — even though the correct amount (Rp 202.500) is in the header. Should fall back to the row payload or hide the grid when the fetch fails.

integration_issues.issue: NOT reachable via UI with current seed — every backlog queue has count <= 2 (max 3), so no board is truncated and SeeAllFooter/see-all button never renders on Beranda (only admin-home-lowstock-see-all exists, which works). Verified via API instead: rows count == count with large limit, truncated=false; with limit=1 truncated=true + hidden=count-1. UI fetch-all path (…-fetching-all) remains unexercised.

design_issues.screen: Retur & Barang Sisa (list) + Retur detail item table
issues: List table has 11 columns squeezed: 'Toko Kain Sejahtera' overlaps the Tipe column and the Dibuat date text overlaps the Umur column (text-on-text collision).

Detail 'ITEM YANG DIRETUR' table (half-width column): 'Alasan' text (Cacat produksi — motif buram) renders on top of the Kondisi/Harga cells and 'Rp 185.000' wraps mid-value. Needs min-widths / horizontal scroll or wider layout.

action_items: POS: portal the 'Semua Filter' modal to document.body and raise z-index above the catalog (>=110) so chips/Terapkan/Reset are clickable and the backdrop dims the cards.
AppViewRouter.jsx line ~311: change SalesReturns onNavigate to (navId, view, tab) => onNavSelect(navId, view, tab) — currently all peta-retur links land on a blank screen.
ApprovalDecisionModal: when detail fetch returns 403/404, hide the detail grid (or fall back to row data) instead of showing '—' / 'Rp 0'.
Tighten Retur Jual list & detail item tables (overlapping cell text).
critical_code_review_comments: MapLink/onNavigate arity mismatch is a systemic risk: AppViewRouter uses 3 different onNavigate signatures ((target), (view), (navId,view,tab)); standardise on (navId, view, tab).
FacetRail modal duplicates overlay markup while ignoring the app's modal z-index ladder (110/120/130 used by CheckoutDrawer/CreateCustomerModal); extract one shared Modal/portal component.
GET /api/sales-returns/{id} enrichment is wrapped in a bare `except Exception: pass` — a pricing lookup failure silently returns a detail with no estimated_value; log it at minimum.

success_rate.frontend: ~75% (POS filter popup blocked, peta-retur links dead; approvals + return stepper flows pass)

rca_of_the_issue: 1) POS filter popup: overlay div (z-[60], not portaled) is a sibling inside the POS view while catalog product cards use .product-card { transform: translateY(0) } which creates stacking contexts painted above it → clicks land on the cards (Playwright reports the product-name <h3> intercepting pointer events). 2) Blank screen from peta retur: prop arity mismatch — AppViewRouter passes a 1-arg onNavigate to SalesReturns, MapLink invokes it with (navId, view, tab), so App.handleNavSelect receives navId as view ('accounts-payable') and AppViewRouter has no branch for that view → empty main.
